description: Wore the yellow and black checks of 1 Sqn in April 1984; the canopy is now covered with black tape
Ex-Blue Impulse; struck off after 27 Mar 2018 and delivered to Kumagaya on 7 Oct 2024; it stood for some time without its nose cone
Fin-only monument beside the education reference hall; the plate records 4050 flying hours and a final flight on 4 Aug 2004 with the paper withdrawal date 20 Oct 2004
